generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Testing complete. The G-code simulator is fully functional:

**Features verified:**
- Linear motion (G0/G1)
- Arc motion (G2/G3) with center and radius format
- Coordinate systems (G54-G59.3, G10)
- G92 coordinate offsets (with proper M2 reset handling)
- G91 incremental mode
- G93 inverse time feed rate
- Canned cycles (G81-G89) with sub-motion expansion
- Block delete (--block-delete flag)
- Probing (G38.2 with --probe-box)
- Trace output with time/distance/position-tolerance sampling
- Tool table and parameter file loading
- Error handling with proper exit codes

All source files are in `/workspace/output/`:
- `main.js` - CLI entry point
- `parser.js` - G-code parser with expression evaluation
- `machine.js` - Machine state model
- `executor.js` - Execution engine
- `arc.js` - Arc geometry calculations
- `canned-cycles.js` - G81-G89 implementation
- `cutter-comp.js` - Cutter radius compensation
- `tool.js` - Tool table parser
- `parameters.js` - Parameter file I/O
- `output.js` - JSON output generation

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
